sentences.text: The FIR has been registered against Dr. A.K. Barethiya, Dy. Director, Animal Husbandry & Dairy Department, Shajapur.

The allegation against the husband of the present petitioner is that he misappropriated amount of Rs.4,12,244/- from the Account of the Government and transferred in the Saving Account of the petitioner and thereafter withdrawn the same.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the present applicant has falsely been implicated in this case.
The applicant is a house wife and her husband was operating the bank account,
therefore, she is not aware or consenting to the aforesaid fraud and transaction.
She also does not know as to how the amount came into her account and was withdrawn.

Under these circumstances,
counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.

4. Learned Govt. Advocate for the respondent/State opposes the bail application by submitting that the applicant is the wife of Govt. employee who is a Government employee and has misappropriated the Government money.

5. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the fact that the main allegation of misappropriation of Government money is against the husband of the applicant, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant deserves to be released on bail.

6. Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant - Priyanka Malviya shall be released upon her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.40,000/-
(Rupees - : 3 :-
Forty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting officer.
This order shall be governed by the conditions No.1 to 3 of sub section (2) of section 438 Cr.P.C.
The applicant shall also co-
operate with the investigation.
With the aforesaid, this M.Cr.C. stands disposed of.
C.C. as per rules.

( VIVEK RUSIA ) JUDGE Alok/-
